description: AlphaFold confidence for BT_0674 and cavity-volume comparison of the substrate channel
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def g(u,**kw):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=300,**kw); r.raise_for_status(); return r
three={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
 'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','LLP':'K','MSE':'M'}
def atoms(txt):
    o=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
            try:o.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),alt=ln[16],resn=ln[17:20].strip(),ch=ln[21],resi=int(ln[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])]),b=float(ln[60:66] or 0)))
            except ValueError:pass
    return [a for a in o if a["alt"] in (" ","A")]

meta=g("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8A9Z1").json()[0]
print("AlphaFold entry:", meta.get("entryId"), "| model version/url:", meta.get("pdbUrl"))
af=atoms(g(meta["pdbUrl"]).text)
pl={a["resi"]:a["b"] for a in af if a["name"]=="CA"}
v=np.array(list(pl.values()))
print(f"{len(v)} residues, mean pLDDT {v.mean():.1f}, %>90 {100*(v>90).mean():.1f}, %>70 {100*(v>70).mean():.1f}, min {v.min():.1f}")
pocket=[42,169,171,174,206,207,239,242,279,283,309,310,338,342,346]
print("pLDDT at mapped active-site residues:", {r:round(pl[r],1) for r in pocket if r in pl})
asm=round(float(np.mean([pl[r] for r in pocket if r in pl])),1); print("mean over those positions:", asm)

ref=atoms(g("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3N29.pdb").text)
tgt=atoms(g("https://files.rcsb.org/download/36GY.pdb").text)
nsd=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in ref if a["resn"]=="NSD"]); cen=nsd.mean(0)
def cavity(prot_xyz, centre, box=11.0, step=0.5, probe=1.4, vdw=1.7, burial=55):
    rng=np.arange(-box,box+1e-9,step)
    G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(rng,rng,rng,indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)+centre
    G=G[np.linalg.norm(G-centre,axis=1)<=box]
    T=cKDTree(prot_xyz); dmin,_=T.query(G)
    nb=np.array([len(x) for x in T.query_ball_point(G,8.0)])
    sel=(dmin>(vdw+probe))&(nb>=burial)
    return sel.sum()*step**3
prot3=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in ref if a["resn"] in three]); v3=cavity(prot3,cen)
cA3={(a["ch"],a["resi"]):a["xyz"] for a in ref if a["name"]=="CA"}
cAt={(a["ch"],a["resi"]):a["xyz"] for a in tgt if a["name"]=="CA"}
anchors=[("A",41,42),("A",166,171),("A",169,174),("A",201,206),("A",202,207),("A",233,239),("A",236,242),
         ("A",272,279),("A",276,283),("A",342,338),("A",346,342),("B",313,309),("B",314,310),("B",350,346)]
P=[];Q=[]
for ch,i,j in anchors:
    if (ch,i) in cA3 and (ch,j) in cAt: P.append(cA3[(ch,i)]);Q.append(cAt[(ch,j)])
P=np.array(P);Q=np.array(Q); pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0)
V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc)); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
rms=float(np.sqrt((((P-pc)@R+qc-Q)**2).sum(1).mean()))
print(f"\nactive-site anchor superposition 3N29 -> 36GY: RMSD {rms:.2f} A over {len(P)} CA anchors")
T=lambda X:(X-pc)@R+qc
protT=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in tgt if a["resn"] in three]); vT=cavity(protT,T(cen))
print(f"buried cavity volume (11 A sphere at the product site): 3N29 {v3:.0f} A^3 | 36GY {vT:.0f} A^3 | ratio {vT/v3:.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax[0].hist(v,bins=np.arange(30,101,2),color="#37474f")
ax[0].axvline(asm,color="#c62828",lw=2,label=f"active-site mean {asm}")
ax[0].set_xlabel("pLDDT"); ax[0].set_ylabel("residues"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_title("AlphaFold model confidence for BT_0674 (Q8A9Z1)",fontsize=10)
lbl=["C. jejuni CANSDC\n3N29, product complex","B. fragilis CASDC\n36GY, 91% id to BT_0674"]
ax[1].bar(lbl,[v3,vT],color=["#8d6e63","#2e7d32"])
for i,val in enumerate([v3,vT]): ax[1].text(i,val+4,f"{val:.0f} $\\AA^3$",ha="center")
ax[1].set_ylabel("buried cavity volume ($\\AA^3$)")
ax[1].set_title("Substrate channel size at the product site",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
